name: slurm-watch
description: Keeps an eye on the Slurm jobs Claude submits: status line, a jobs panel, and a note with what each job used when it ends

hosts.title: Hosts
hosts.description: The ssh hosts slurm-watch may ask about jobs: names and *.domain patterns, separated by commas. A job sent to any other host is listed but never checked. Jump hosts must be listed too.
